BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning defenses in personal injury and wrongful death actions where the person injured or killed was committing a felony.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to defenses in personal injury and wrongful death actions where the person injured or killed was committing a felony; amending RCW 4.24.420; and creating a new section.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 4.24.420 and 1987 c 212 s 901 are each amended to read as follows:Action by person committing a felony—Defense—Actions under 42 U.S.C. Sec. 1983.
BillSection.P: It is a complete defense to any action for damages for personal injury or wrongful death that the person injured or killed was engaged in the commission has been convicted of a class A or a class B felony at the time of the occurrence causing the injury or death and the felony the commission of which was a proximate cause of the injury or death. However, nothing in this section shall affect a right of action under 42 U.S.C. Sec. 1983.

AnnNote.NoteP: Preamble—Report to legislature—Applicability—Severability—1986 c 305: See notes following RCW 4.16.160.

BillSectionHeader.P: This act is remedial and applies retroactively to all claims or causes of action commenced prior to or after the effective date of this section regardless of when the claim or cause of action arose.
